name: Can I install closet lighting myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I install closet lighting myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While simple, battery-operated closet lights can often be installed as a DIY project, hardwired solutions typically require a professional. Installing wired lighting involves working with electrical circuits, which can be dangerous if not done correctly. A professional ensures that the installation meets all safety codes, is properly grounded, and functions reliably. Hiring a general contractor like City Dweller, LLC ensures the job is done safely, efficiently, and to high standards, especially if new wiring or structural modifications are needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple, battery-operated lights can be DIY, but hardwired installations should be done by a professional for safety and code compliance.
